jobs.title: Senior Director, Technology Infrastructure Operations & Resiliency
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

As the Senior Director, Technology Infrastructure Operations & Resiliency, you will lead the shift of Royal Bank of Canada's Technology Operations & Resiliency (TOR) team to a proactive, data-driven model that closes problems before they affect clients. The Senior Director will define this new operating model and the KPIs and tools that run it, and will drive the AIOps and automation adoption that underpins cost and resource optimization across Technology Infrastructure and Technology and Operations & Resiliency.

What will you do?

Define the new proactive operating model, including process, cadence, governance, and data collection architecture.
Define operational KPIs (internal and external), RAG thresholds, and drill-in views across daily, monthly, quarterly, yearly, and historical timeframes.
Design the data model behind operational views and work with the Data Governance committee to onboard new data elements and identify trusted sources.
Lead development of operational views and data collection using tools such as AIOps, Mission Control, Elastic, and Power BI.
Own the product roadmap and lead agile sprints for the initial transformation and continuous improvement.
Drive adoption of AI for data analysis and automation, including RBC Internal AI tools, RBC Deep Research, and Mission Control.
Lead operational change management to build understanding and adoption of the new model.

What do you need to succeed?

Must-have

BSc, with experience spanning business and technology in large-scale enterprise business engineering
Experience designing, building, and scaling an enterprise-grade business engineering platform
Hands-on experience with Power BI, Elastic, AI/LLM development, DevOps toolchains, and Kanban boards
ITIL knowledge, with strength in proactive problem management and continuous improvement
Proven people leadership experience, including building teams, developing leaders, and driving operational change

Nice-to-have

MBA

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
Flexible work/life balance options
Opportunities to do challenging work
Opportunities to take on progressively greater accountabilities
Access to a variety of job opportunities across business

#TECHPJ

Job Skills

Big Data Management, Budgeting, Business Case Design, Business Performance Management, Business Statistics, Critical Thinking, Knowledge Organization, Long Term Planning, Operational Requirements, Performance Management (PM)

jobs.title: Head of Advisor Technology - Americas
jobs.description:
Provides the strategic direction, oversees and leads a team of technical support staff who design, develop, test, implement and monitor software and tools. Acts as a subject matter expert and thought leader, and manages the implementation of divisional products. Manages Leads the evaluation and selection of IT vendor products. Partners with leaders to strategize and effectively shape IT demand that will deliver business impact.

Provides the strategic direction, oversees and leads a team of technical support staff who design, develop, test, implement and monitor software and tools. Acts as a subject matter expert and thought leader, and manages the implementation of divisional products. Manages Leads the evaluation and selection of IT vendor products. Partners with leaders to strategize and effectively shape IT demand that will deliver business impact.

Core Responsibilities

Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
Provides full strategic ownership for delivering software releases relating to the product for the business units, managing the testing, evaluation, and selection of IT vendor products. Works with business clients to determine scope, and develops and implements environmental requirements for each project.
Develops and implements staffing and operational plans. Effectively leverages various staffing options and manages a global workforce. Develops and implements short and long term department goals and ensures alignment with the overall strategy. Monitors service delivery metrics and overall performance.
Develops and implements changes to department policies and procedures to meet changing business needs and to achieve department objectives. Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement and implements appropriate strategies and technologies for building products and delivering services.
Leads quality initiatives to improve the delivery of service levels. Plans, develops, and executes short and long range goals to ensure divisional success.
Develops and maintains relationships with key stakeholders to provide long-term collaborations and deliver successful business outcomes.
Reviews expenses and ensures department operates within budgetary guidelines. Leads the strategy and execution to build, buy, and integrate business technology solutions.
Ensures staff complies with information technology and information security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum of ten years related work experience, with at least five years of project management experience.
Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of training and experience. Graduate degree preferred.

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for the majority of our crew members, designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.
